intent:
"yes approbe and begin the implementation" started the bstack build slice by slice, strictly one at a time ("keep it sequential"). Later: "i'm only not concerned about security hardening, threat-model concerns. Style and simplification and following proper design principles are still important." - build the full app fast, but review the core properly so slices and phases do not leave bugs.

The plans of record are in the repo: `docs/design.md` (requirements and decisions, including R24: licensing is out of scope) and `docs/implementation-plan.md` (tasks, task evidence contract). knowttl/bstack is public, has no GitHub Actions or workflows and no release automation, and ships through the no-mistakes pipeline with automatic merge of green work. Landed: Phase 0, Phase 1, T2.1-T2.3 and T2.4 (https://github.com/knowttl/bstack/pull/23: `measure` and `overlap`, with the merge-path-reuse limitation documented; its final evidence refresh was deferred to this slice).

This piece is slice C13: task T2.5 "Build the findings schema and report". Done evidence: principle/source/selection validation, scratch-only output, stage-specific readiness controls.
amendments: Firstmate authorised fresh runs and an evidence-only commit after the completed pipeline's documentation repairs, followed by a second no-mistakes run. All five C13 command artifacts were regenerated against f665b6cc36b44e517f6f5b189f14da27fc720d39.

cases.procedure: findings validate rejects missing principle without target writes; findings validate rejects unknown status without target writes; render separates source intent, selected debt and new principles in scratch.
readiness handles unresolved decision; readiness handles unselected new principle; audit requires current evidence before ready; foundation requires current evidence before ready.

findings validate rejects unknown source without target writes; findings validate rejects selection mismatch without target writes; readiness handles failed journey despite passing units; changed intent or selection invalidates otherwise passed evidence.

limitations: Recorded execution is Linux on Node 24. Real Windows and macOS execution remains captain checklist evidence.
These automated controls establish the findings command contract. Full agent acceptance for AC-8, AC-63 and AC-65 remains planned in the acceptance registry.
Readiness checks supplied observations and exact artifact freshness, without executing checks or independently proving their truth. Automatic capture belongs to T2.7.

Audit requires current starting-checks and any declared scope outcomes. Foundation requires journey and foundation-review plus declared outcomes. Maintained enforcement and portable assessment remain later tasks.
